描述_EN: a second frame features a red band with a bird in flight facing right. the third and final border is adorned with small reserve fleuron motifs set against a blue background. the very naturalistic decoration, in reserve on a red background, depicts a seated putto, holding a bird in front of him in the direction of another putto facing him. Red fragmentary shoulder square with triple framing. the latter, seated, holds a garnished cup in front of him. this motif is framed by borders composed of stylized meanders between two fine edgings.
